entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who is abbot of Keral Keep on Regatha, who peeks at Zendikar, then resigns and returns to fight there.

entities.name: Mother Luti
entities.description: A senior monk of Keral Keep who outranks the abbot and tests Chandra's resolve before blessing her departure.

entities.name: Abbot Serenok
entities.description: A former abbot of Keral Keep whose robe Chandra wears.

entities.name: Jaya
entities.description: The beloved founder figure whose teachings the monks of Keral Keep follow.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who leads the Zendikari hedron operation at Sea Gate.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who asked for Chandra's help on Zendikar.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A merfolk mage directing an octopoid monster with a two-pronged spear; this page does not name her.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan approaching Sea Gate, trapped in a hedron ring and then freed.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Alien creatures that afflict Zendikar, including scouts Chandra fights.

entities.name: Keral Keep
entities.description: The monastery of pyromancer-monks on Regatha where Chandra is abbot.

entities.name: Regatha
entities.description: The plane of Keral Keep where Chandra has accepted the abbacy.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane where the battle against the Eldrazi rages.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The white-towered coastal city where the Zendikari fight Ulamog.

entities.name: Mount Keralia Address
entities.description: The traditional speech given by the abbot of Keral Keep.

entities.name: Hedron prison
entities.description: A ring of floating hedrons that traps Ulamog and is later broken after a demon draws power from it.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes from which the Eldrazi titans come.

events.summary: Chandra, abbot of Keral Keep, cannot write her Mount Keralia Address and struggles to keep her promise to stay on Regatha.
Chandra planeswalks to Zendikar for just one peek and lands near Sea Gate.
events.quote: She pressed her will against the whereness around her, forcing it to change.

events.summary: Chandra watches Gideon direct the placement of a hedron into the ring over the water.
events.quote: One of the larger hedrons, hovering over the water, was moving .

events.summary: A scout on a manta nearly spots Chandra, who runs into three Eldrazi.
events.quote: she was face-to-faceplate with a trio of angular, meaty-ribbed, bony-headed creatures.

events.summary: Chandra kills the three Eldrazi with fire.
events.quote: creating a tripartite blade of fire that sliced through each one of them.

events.summary: As she leaves, Chandra sees Ulamog advancing on Sea Gate and realizes this is what she helped unleash.
events.quote: This was what she had helped unleash.

events.summary: Back on Regatha, Mother Luti summons Chandra to the Address, and Chandra burns her speech.
events.quote: The pages burst into flames, burning up in a flash.

events.summary: Chandra gives a clumsy address, then tells the monks to trust themselves and find their own purposes.
Chandra announces she is leaving for Zendikar and Mother Luti forbids it, invoking her promise.
Mother Luti reveals it was a test, blesses Chandra's departure and takes back the abbot's robe.
Chandra arrives at Sea Gate and finds Ulamog trapped in the hedron ring while Zendikari cheer.
A winged demon draws power from the hedron prison, causing the hedrons to fall and freeing Ulamog.
Chandra fails to hurt the demon or the titan, and a second Eldrazi titan rises from the ground.
events.quote: A second Eldrazi titan had entered the battle.

relations.note: Chandra is abbot of Keral Keep.
relations.quote: she has accepted the position of abbot for a monastery of pyromancer-monks.

relations.note: Luti and Serenok taught Chandra as a child, and Luti outranks her.
relations.quote: The people of this place—Abbot Serenok, Mother Luti, all of you—you showed me.

relations.note: Chandra considers Gideon and Jace her friends.
She helped unleash the Eldrazi and tries to fight them.
relations.quote: This—Ulamog— this was what the true battle was about.
